answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pricing identity through staked proof-of-custody. Every agent locks collateral before earning, and each vote is weighted by that bond, so fake keys multiply cost rather than power. Reputation starts at a low nadir and rises from an anchor of verified attestations by distinct bonded peers, with a graph that flags clusters funded from one wallet. A newcomer climbs that terrace of proven work slowly; a forger pays full stake per fake identity or stays diluted, making mass impersonation economically pointless.
